title: KinematicFeatures
description: Per-frame, per-hand causal feature vector (Phase 01 contract; produced by features, Phase 08). The meaning and order of values is fixed by the feature schema named in feature_schema_id (Phase 08, schemas/feature-schema-v1.json); this record only fixes the envelope. docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.5.

feature_schema_id.description: Id of the feature schema that defines values[] (e.g. 'fs-v1', Phase 08). Consumers refuse a mismatch.

values.description: F floats; units per feature are declared in the feature schema. NaN/Inf forbidden (use mask).

mask.description: F booleans; false marks a feature that could not be computed causally at this frame (e.g. insufficient history). Same length as values.

dt.description: t_capture(this frame) - t_capture(previous processed frame for this hand); the actual, not nominal, frame interval.

track_status.description: Status of the TrackState this vector derives from; carried so consumers need not join records.
